title: Hook Generator
description: Generate a TanStack React Query hook (useQuery for GET actions, useMutation otherwise) wrapping an existing server action.

name.description: Name of the action to wrap (e.g., getUsers, createPost). Determines the hook name (use<Name>) and whether useQuery or useMutation is used.
name.x-prompt: What action would you like to generate a hook for?

package.description: Subdirectory within src/ where hooks are created (default: 'hooks' creates src/hooks/)

directory.description: Override the entire directory path for hook creation

projectName.description: Target project name where hook will be generated. Auto-creates feature if not found.

actionPackage.description: Subdirectory within src/ where the wrapped action lives (default: 'lib/actions', matching the action generator's default)

actionFile.description: Optional: exact file (without extension) the wrapped action was written to, if it differs from the default resource-based name

clientPackage.description: API client package to import ApiError from. Use @next-feature/client (default) or custom package like @myorg/api-client

skipFormat.description: Skip prettier code formatting (used internally for chained generators)

export.description: Export the generated hook from project root src/index.ts (default: true)
